param_reference.location: region filter chips in UI; URL form remoteok.com/remote-{tag}-jobs?location=IN for country

extract_js: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/remote-jobs/"]')).map(a => ({ href: a.href.split('?')[0], title: a.innerText?.slice(0, 120) || '' })).filter(x => /\/remote-jobs\/(remote-)?[a-z0-9-]*\d/.test(x.href)).reduce((acc, x) => { if (!acc.find(y => y.href === x.href)) acc.push(x); return acc; }, []).slice(0, 20)
rules: Use tag slugs, not free text — map prompt roles via keyword_slug_map (one slug per URL)
All jobs are remote — check listing body for region restriction (Worldwide vs US-only etc.)
Salary shown is employer-entered — verify inside listing before writing Pay to Details
Verify finalists with WebFetch; WebFetch works without login
notes: Seeded 2026-08-20 — tag page verified live (remote-backend-jobs, 626 results)
High volume aggregator; also exposes public JSON API at remoteok.com/api if page scrape is thin
